answer: An attacker with 5,000 POA tries to open fake accounts at a pearl registry. Each new account needs a sponsor who locks 40 POA for 30 epochs, and one sponsor can back only 3 accounts. Fake N=1 needs 40 POA; N=100 needs 34 sponsors, so 1,360 POA locked, and one sponsor's lock cannot cover another. Validators sample 1 in 6 sponsors, reading the jetty audit log and vault slashing record. Honest users borrow a sponsor free. Slashed sponsors appeal within 5 epochs. It fails if sponsors collude.
